# harness-ledger

> harness-ledger works with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor: it reads the session transcripts your agent already saves, maps the project's harness (instructions, skills, subagents, commands, hooks, settings) and suggests evidence-based changes with their costs.

Numbers (time, tokens, money) come from a local script, never from the model. Transcripts stay on the machine; links that leave it carry only shapes, names and counts. Install the skill with `npx skills add guilhermebkel/harness-ledger -g` (it asks which agents to install for: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), then ask the agent to run `audit-harness` (`/audit-harness` in Claude Code).
